title: Step inside Masquerade’s Phantom story
description: Masquerade retells The Phantom of the Opera as an immersive New York production. Instead of watching every scene from a fixed seat, you move through designed rooms as music and performers draw you into the story. The closeness changes how you notice a glance, a costume, or a familiar song; check the current ticket and access details before you go.
teaser: Follow the Phantom through rooms, music, and masks.
goodToKnow: The experience involves walking and standing through multiple rooms; ask about accessible routes and current tickets.
whyItMightDelightYou: Being close to the performers can make a well-known story feel newly uncertain and alive.
